Garnet Mantle.name: Garnet Mantle
Garnet Mantle.description: The user lays a thin skin of their blood over their whole body and keeps it half-liquid, hardening each patch the instant something strikes it. For the rest of the scene blades, bullets and blows stop at the mantle, which flows back over any gap, and the user can harden any part of it into hooked spikes that deal piercing damage to anyone grappling them; held back, the spikes only grip clothing. It stops no heat, gas or electricity, and when it falls the user has lost a large share of their health. Strain: severe.
